declaration.preface:
At RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to ensuring that our employees are compensated fairly for their contributions. Our Fair Wage Policy underscores our dedication to providing equitable, transparent, and competitive wages that align with industry standards and the specific needs of our workforce. We regularly benchmark our compensation against industry pay scales, taking into account factors such as job role, experience, and performance to ensure fairness.

We believe that fair compensation is essential for fostering employee satisfaction and loyalty. By providing wages that support our employee’ financial stability, we enable them to meet their essential needs and maintain a reasonable standard of living. This commitment not only enhances their overall well-being but also motivates them to contribute positively to our organizational goals, fostering a positive work environment where every employee feels valued and respected.
declaration.declaration: At RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to ensuring that all employees receive fair, competitive wages aligned with their skills and contributions. With a baseline set for the year 2022-23, we will regularly assess market rates and maintain internal pay equity. Transparent communication regarding compensation matters will be prioritized, fostering an inclusive workplace for equal opportunities in career advancement.

definitions.title: Living Wage Definition & Methodology
definitions.content:
By providing wages that support our employee’ financial stability, we enable them to meet their essential needs and maintain a reasonable standard of living.

We regularly benchmark our compensation against industry pay scales, taking into account factors such as job role, experience, and performance to ensure fairness.

At RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd., we are committed to ensuring that all employees receive fair, competitive wages aligned with their skills and contributions. With a baseline set for the year 2022-23, we will regularly assess market rates and maintain internal pay equity.

focusAreas: Annual review of wages and equitable compensation
Communication and transparency regarding wage changes
Employee feedback on wage fairness and job satisfaction
Career advancement, skills development, and fair wage increases

Annual review of wages and equitable com: Regularly conduct an annual review of wages to ensure equitable compensation across all departments, regardless of gender, age, or background.
Communication and transparency regarding: Ensure that employees receive clear and timely communication on any changes to their wages, explaining the rationale behind adjustments, to foster trust and transparency.
Employee feedback on wage fairness and j: Maintain a feedback mechanism for employees to voice concerns and suggestions related to wage fairness and job satisfaction.
Career advancement, skills development,: Develop comprehensive career advancement programs that equip employees with the necessary skills for professional growth, thereby facilitating opportunities for fair wage increases.

targets.target: Maintain an employee satisfaction score of at least 90% regarding fair wages in annual surveys
Ensure that 100% of identified wage adjustments are implemented within six months of the annual review.
targets.deadline: Within six months of the annual review

targets.target: Ensure that at least 75% of employees receive a wage increase based on performance and skill development every year.
Aim for an employee retention rate of 90% or higher annually, indicating satisfaction with compensation and overall job satisfaction.

policy.monitoring:
The tracking and reporting on the effectiveness of the Fair Wage Policy will presented through the annual Fair Wage Performance Report. This report will provide transparency on key metrics such as wage growth, compliance with industry standards, and feedback from employees on wage fairness. These metrics will help identify areas for improvement and ensure that wages remain competitive.

The report will be presented to the senior management annually and shared with employee representatives to maintain transparency.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Fair Wage Policy will be reviewed annually by the HR, in collaboration with the Compliance Officer. The review will consider current economic trends, inflation rates, industry standards, and employee feedback. Any necessary updates to the wage structure will be made to ensure continuous alignment with best practices and the company's commitment to wage fairness.
